description: AbstractSalesManagerCoreTestCase.java is a Java abstract class used as a base for core integration tests in the SalesManager project. It sets up the testing context, configuration, and common dependencies for testing core services related to product, customer, order, and other business functions.

classes.name: AbstractSalesManagerCoreTestCase
classes.description: An abstract base class for core test cases providing dependencies and setup methods for testing the sales management system
